transformation_policy: Only release paths, schema/provenance metadata, external-output plumbing, validation hardening and explicitly documented reproducibility prose were changed. Mathematical source/certificate payloads are preserved. Manifest records do not hash themselves. The rc2-authors finalization changes only author/title metadata, the canonical PDF, project licensing/administrative documents and regenerated manifests. All scientific source outside the main title metadata, all computational input/output data and all inherited verification/build sources remain byte-identical to rc1.
